gaps.reason: Core lineage verifies task replies/evidence/receipts/decision, while candidate learning lineage is embedded in generation outcomes; no API traverses candidate -> package -> review -> correction -> derived candidate.
Rollback and memory invalidation are separate capabilities; no transaction discovers lineage descendants and invalidates candidate, memory, review evidence, canary and readiness atomically.
Guards validate target sets and forbidden code behaviors, but no canonical versioned registry defines protected safety paths, symbols and invariants for every candidate write route.

Existing engines select request implementation or execution routes and gate complexity; none compares multiple code candidates using one vector spanning performance, memory, safety, compatibility, change surface, rollback cost and Rust migration value.

conclusion: All four Phase 81 gaps remain confirmed after inspecting the nearest existing alternatives.
